decisions.label: Chase past the edge
decisions.note: How far past their area's edge wild animals follow her once they're after her (her 💌 provoked them, or the warning ran out with her inside). Ed: chase outside, relatively far.

decisions.label: Provoked for
decisions.note: Seconds a 💌 landing on a wild animal provokes it to come out after her across its edge (sniping from just outside). 0: never.
